title: chore: update app metrics 2026-08-11
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt: Daily automated update of app metrics, health checks, and greenhouse

gist.headline: The greenhouse got its rounds
gist.blurb: The bot made its daily walk through the app garden, refreshing health checks and catalog notes. Even the seedlings have telemetry now.
gist.summary: Refreshed the daily app metrics, health-check data, and greenhouse catalog entries in apps/GREENHOUSE.md and apps/catalog.json for 2026-08-11.
gist.impact: Community app listings and greenhouse status records stay current with the latest automated metrics.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy greenhouse maintenance scene: Polli checks a clipboard of app-health readings beside labeled code-plants, while a small CRT monitor robot displays tidy green status lights. Freshly watered plants and a catalog shelf represent the daily refresh rather than a new product feature.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel-art greenhouse where the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings wears a tiny gardener visor and checks a clipboard beside code-plants with healthy status lights; a chunky CRT monitor robot updates a small app catalog shelf. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, warm lighting, flowers and vines, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with subtle pixel-font text: "DAILY CHECK". Nostalgic but beautiful, emotionally warm.
